_comment: The codex model (no persona prefix) every live codex test and smoke sends turns to: smoke-router.sh checks 8-9, smoke-tool-search.sh --codex, the codex legs in test/tool-search-shared.mjs, conditional/effort-mapping-codex.test.mjs and conditional/tool-search-metered.test.mjs.
